CreateConsumerGroup.description_en: Creates a consumer group by calling the CreateConsumerGroup operation
CreateConsumerGroup.description_zh: 调用 CreateConsumerGroup 创建 Consumer Group

CreateTopic.description_en: Creates a topic by calling the CreateTopic operation
CreateTopic.description_zh: 调用 CreateTopic 创建 Topic

DeleteConsumerGroup.description_en: Calls the DeleteConsumerGroup operation to delete a consumer group
DeleteConsumerGroup.description_zh: 调用 DeleteConsumerGroup 删除 ConsumerGroup

DeleteTopic.description_en: Calls the DeleteTopic operation to delete a topic
DeleteTopic.description_zh: 调用 DeleteTopic 删除 Topic

GetConsumerList.description_en: Calls GetConsumerList to retrieve the list of consumer groups
GetConsumerList.description_zh: 调用 GetConsumerList 获取 Consumer Group 列表

GetConsumerProgress.description_en: Queries the consumption status of a consumer group by calling GetConsumerProgress
GetConsumerProgress.description_zh: 调用 GetConsumerProgress 查询 Consumer Group 的消费状态

GetInstanceList.description_en: Calls the GetInstanceList operation to query information about instances that you purchased in a specific region
GetInstanceList.description_zh: 调用 GetInstanceList 获取您在某地域下所购买的实例的信息

GetTopicList.description_en: Calls the GetTopicList operation to retrieve the list of topics
GetTopicList.description_zh: 调用 GetTopicList 获取 Topic 的列表

GetTopicStatus.description_en: Calls the GetTopicStatus operation to retrieve the message sending and receiving data of a topic
GetTopicStatus.description_zh: 调用 GetTopicStatus 获取 Topic 的消息收发数据
